meta.note: Specs and terms are transcribed from vendor official pages; fields not stated on official pages read "Check the official page" or null. group values: intl (international SMS APIs), china (China cloud SMS), platform (platform verification), simple (simple API). category values: trial (time-limited trial), payg (pay-as-you-go), package (packages), free-tier (ongoing daily allowance). cardRequired null means the official page does not state it. verifyFee 0 means zero verification fees or no platform fee; null means the official page does not state it or wording conflicts. Conflicting wording appears in each entry conflicts array, shown side by side with no ruling. AWS SNS is a clarification note only and is not in the data file. Huawei Cloud SMS has shut down and has no entry.

offers.title: Twilio trial and Verify
offers.specText: 30-day trial, no credit card required; 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp messages, 75 voice minutes, 3,000 emails, 40 Verify verifications, 100 Lookup requests; Verify $0.05 per successful verification plus channel fees
offers.durationText: 30 days; upgrading grants a fresh set of free allowances
offers.cardNote: No credit card required for the trial (official trial docs); payment methods after upgrading — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: Verified numbers only, at most 5 recipients per account; SMS and voice limited to the country of registration; Twilio templates required
offers.overageBehavior: Trial allowance expires after 30 days; pay-as-you-go prices are on the detail page
risks: Trial messages can only go to verified numbers, at most 5 recipients per account
Trial messaging must use Twilio-provided templates; custom content is not supported
The trial number is shared and cannot be kept after upgrading
Failed or expired Verify attempts skip the base fee, but SMS attempts are always billed
offers.sourceName: Twilio official trial docs and pricing pages
offers.notes: Upgrading grants a fresh set of free allowances (100 messages, 40 verifications, and more); upgrading directly at signup adds a 30% bonus (except Conversations and the first-month free number). Coverage 180+ countries, with China in the supported-countries table. Current 10DLC prices (after the 2025-08-01 increase): brand registration $4.50/$46 one-time, campaigns $15 review fee plus monthly fees.
offers.trialNote: Plus 100 WhatsApp messages, 75 voice minutes, 3,000 emails, 40 Verify verifications, 100 Lookup requests; verified numbers only, at most 5 recipients; templates required.
